notes: Conservative propulsion tier capacities for first-pass CubeSat optimization.
delta_v_support_mps is a proxy for achievable total delta-v capability for typical CubeSat-class systems in the tier.
propellant_volume_u is packaging volume proxy for tanks/feed system (not including keep-outs).

field_descriptions.delta_v_support_mps: Delta-v capability proxy used to satisfy propulsion need class mapping.
field_descriptions.propellant_volume_u: Volume proxy for tanks/feed/valves (used for volume closure).
field_descriptions.prop_avg_power_w: Average propulsion subsystem power draw proxy (used in power closure when propulsion is active).
field_descriptions.prop_peak_power_w: Peak propulsion subsystem power draw proxy (used in peak-power feasibility).
field_descriptions.prop_mass_kg: Propulsion dry mass proxy (not including propellant mass in this first-pass library).
